home.title: Own a home, or a share of one.
home.lead: Buy outright, rent, or invest from just 1% of a property. Every share is legally registered in your name.

about.title: Real estate ownership, made shareable.
about.lead: Shariki (شريكي) means “my partner” in Arabic. We believe owning property in Syria shouldn't be limited to the few who can pay the full price upfront. So we split properties into shares anyone can own, and we handle everything from paperwork to handover.

mission.title: Make property investment accessible to everyone
mission.lead: Real estate has always been one of the safest ways to protect and grow savings. We're opening it up to a much wider part of society.
points: Investment accessible to every budget, not just big buyers.
Additional income for families through profit sharing.
Better financial awareness about collective investment.
A trusted, inclusive community of investors and owners.

offer.title: Sales, purchases, rentals and shares
offer.lead: One platform for every way of owning real estate.

items.title: Smart real estate investment
items.text: Collective investment from 1% to 100% of a property. Open to every budget and ideal for Syrians abroad looking for opportunities at home.

items.title: A platform for projects
items.text: Developers and owners showcase their projects. We divide each property into small shares that many investors can buy securely.

items.title: Secure ownership
items.text: Every investor owns a legally registered share in their name and receives returns in proportion to that share.

how.title: From listing to ownership in four steps

steps.title: Owners list a property
steps.text: Sell it whole, rent it out, or open it to investors share by share.

steps.title: We verify it
steps.text: Our team reviews every listing and its papers before it goes live.

steps.title: Buyers & investors request
steps.text: Request the whole property or any share you like, then pay securely.

steps.title: Contract & returns
steps.text: The legal contract is registered in your name and returns follow your share.

fees.title: Transparent from day one
fees.lead: Licensed by the Ministry of Supply (Company Register No. 2222) and registered with the Ministry of Finance (Tax No. 2222).

items.title: Commission on sales
items.text: A single, transparent 2% commission on every completed property sale. No hidden fees.

items.title: Annual rentals
items.text: For yearly rentals, the platform fee is equal to one month of rent.

items.title: Monthly rentals
items.text: For rentals of one month or more (but less than a year), the platform charges 10% of the rent.

items.title: Legal supervision
items.text: A licensed legal agency reviews every contract across all provinces before any money changes hands.

cta.title: Ready to own your first share?
cta.text: Explore properties open for investment and start from as little as 1%.
